g.text: Stock Tweedie: forecasts stay near 1 unit a week while sales are near zero

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: Shaded = gap between N-HiTS Tweedie and N-HiTS Huber. Dotted lines = forecast origins. WMAPE = sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales; |bias| = |total forecast / total actual - 1|.

text.style: fill: #555555; font: 7.5px 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'

g.text: the forecast weeks while N-HiTS Tweedie forecast 0.9-1.2 a week.

g.text: HOUSEHOLD_2_245_TX_1 is rank 1 of 820 candidates. 829 of 4,979 series with at least 50% zero weeks (17%) have the N-HiTS Tweedie forecast at 0.9 a week or more

g.text: while actual sales average under 0.5 a week.
